name: crisismesh-member4-backend
description: CrisisMesh AI — Member 4 backend slice: Authority Dashboard API + Post-Disaster AI Agent. Intended to be merged into the main CrisisMesh Express server, not run standalone.
notes: Node >=18 is required because ai/postDisasterAgent/agent.js uses the global fetch() API instead of adding node-fetch as a dependency.

Do not run `npm install` for this package in isolation as a way to launch a server — there is no server entry file here by design. See ../INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md: these dependencies are meant to be merged into the main project's existing backend package.json.
If the main project's backend already declares express and/or firebase-admin, do not install a second, conflicting version — align on one version across the whole backend.
